admission.justification: The table alone names the lists, the server narrowing alone hides and refuses tools, and the seat grant alone approves them; only together does a role seat see, call and hold approval for exactly the same ordered list.

guarantee: A role-launched agents-remember-task server advertises and dispatches exactly the ordered allowlist that the canonical table holds for its role, a tool outside it is unknown to that process, and a fresh Codex seat of that role is granted the same ordered list; an unbound server and an explainer-only server keep the whole public roster, and an unreadable role binding serves only server_info.
title: A role seat sees, calls and is granted one ordered tool list
